s.x: Galatea's trees are chopped differently from the rest of SkyBlock. Hit a log with an axe and you take it, plus extra logs if your
is high enough for the tree's
Cut out of order and your Sweep only counts for half. Fig Fortune and Mangrove Fortune (on top of Foraging Fortune) give extra logs.
When the last log falls, everyone who cut at least a tenth of the tree gets a

: Forest Essence, Foraging XP and a chance of Tender Wood or Vinesap. If you cut a fifth of the tree the gift is 1.5 times bigger, and if you cut a third it's doubled, so chopping together pays. The tree grows back a minute later.
